rules: Choose duration from information density, not from a fixed platform target.
For substantial current-events explainers, prefer roughly 8 minutes and allow up to about 10 minutes when context materially improves understanding.
Do not pad a thin topic to hit a duration target; a clear 6-7 minute video is better than a repetitive 10 minute video.
Cover the prior context, triggering event, verified current facts, what changed, why it matters, uncertainty, and likely next developments when source material supports them.
Remove duplicated explanations before shortening substantive context.
Keep full spoken-word subtitle coverage at 100 percent.
Keep Zundamon stationary within each scene; vary pose/expression between scenes instead of continuous translation motion.
Use visual hierarchy for title, chapter heading, subheading, normal subtitles, and emphasized keywords through distinct size and color treatment.
